name: Plate Tone
desc: Turns the frame into a hand-pulled intaglio print — the film of ink the rag never quite wiped off, dragged in one direction across the plate, foul bite creeping in patches, laid and chain lines pressed through from the damp rag paper, and the debossed plate mark biting a bevel into the margin as a gallery lamp rakes across it.

tone.doc: how much ink the rag left behind — density of the residual film over the whole frame

wipe.doc: hand-wipe streaking: how many drag marks and how hard they read

energy.doc: raking gallery lamp — sheen amplitude and how deep the plate bevel reads

speed.doc: rate multiplier on the re-wipe drift, the wipe angle and the lamp

hue.doc: ink hue — 30 is a warm intaglio brown-black; carries the paper with it

plate.doc: plate-mark inset — 0 prints full bleed, higher leaves a wider bare-paper margin

grain.doc: how much rag fibre, laid and chain line press through

scale.doc: feature size of the tone mottle and the laid lines

x.doc: where the lamp rakes from, x

y.doc: where the lamp rakes from, y

act.doc: multi-minute program: the wipe breathes / clean proofs, barely any tone / a long edition, the plate holding more and more ink

style.doc: aesthetic: warm brown-black plate tone on cream / cool granular rosin bite / soft dragged veils, smoky and directional / velvety burr with a heavy plate edge / inverted — the pass lightens instead of darkening, a washed-out ghost proof

seed.doc: deterministic plate and sheet — mottle, foul bite, wipe marks, plate-mark placement
